Solve repository QA in read-only mode with tool calls only.
Rules:
1. Use list_dir/read_file tools only (get_repo_map is disabled).
2. Prefer relative paths. Repo files are usually like src/...; instance files are usually files/....
3. Minimize unnecessary reads and repeated failed paths.
4. read_file has a hard per-call limit: at most 300 lines.
5. When you are completely done using tools, reply with exactly DONE_WITH_FILE_READING.
6. Do not combine the completion signal with the final JSON answer.
7. After the follow-up prompt closes the tool phase, first write a brief derivation (a few sentences) explaining how the code you read determines the answer, then write '## Answer' on its own line followed by exactly one JSON object matching template_answer keys and value types.
8. Put only the JSON object after the '## Answer' line — no markdown code fences, and nothing after the JSON.

Question kind: M1_IntraProceduralCFG

Question:
Use `tests/qa/testcase.py`, class `TestForEachValueRefBranchExecutionCoverageQA`. The class contains 15 test methods (`test_branch_execution_case_01` through `..._case_15`). Each method instantiates `cfnlint.template.Template("foo.yaml", template_dict, [region])` with a per-test region and Parameters dict, then constructs `_ForEachValueRef(get_hash(ref_name), ref_name)` and calls `.value(cfn, runtime_params)` exactly ONCE. The (region, ref_name, parameters, runtime_params) tuple varies per test to deliberately exercise a SUBSET of the conditional branches inside `_ForEachValueRef.value` (lines 452-531 of `src/cfnlint/template/transforms/_language_extensions.py`). QUESTION: across ALL 15 test methods, which exact line numbers inside `_ForEachValueRef.value` are covered (i.e., emitted as `event=line`) at LEAST ONCE? Return JSON with exactly one key `covered_lines`: `{"covered_lines": [<int>, ...]}` where the value is a sorted list of unique integers in ascending order. Reasoning rules to simulate (per-test): (1) `_drive_value(region, ref_name, parameters, runtime_params)` builds a fresh `Template("foo.yaml", {"Parameters": parameters or {}, "Resources": {"Bucket": {"Type": "AWS::S3::Bucket"}}}, [region])` and calls `_ForEachValueRef(get_hash(ref_name), ref_name).value(cfn, runtime_params)`. (2) Inside `.value`: line 458 evaluates `if params is None:`. If True, line 459 sets `params = {}`. Line 460 calls `self._ref.value(cfn, params)` -> returns the string `ref_name`. Line 462 evaluates `if not isinstance(v, str):` (always False here). Line 465 evaluates `if v in params:`. If True, line 466 returns early -- nothing else in the function runs. (3) Otherwise the function continues to lines 468 (if only_params -- always False here), 471 (region = cfn.regions[0]), 472 (account_id), 473 (partition = "aws"), 474 (if region in gov pair), 475 (gov partition assignment -- only entered when region is us-gov-east-1 / us-gov-west-1), 476 (if region in cn pair), 477 (cn partition assignment -- only entered when region is cn-north-1 / cn-northwest-1). (4) Then the AWS::* dispatch chain at 478, 481, 486, 489, 492, 495, 502, 505. The HEAD of each `if` is evaluated until one matches; matched body runs, then the function returns -- subsequent if-heads are NOT evaluated. (5) For ref_names not matching any AWS::*: lines 511-531 do parameter resolution. Line 511 fetches `p = cfn.template.get("Parameters", {}).get(v)`. Line 512 (`if not p:`) raises at 513 if `p` is None. Otherwise lines 514, 515 (`if t.startswith("AWS::SSM::Parameter")`), 517 (default = p.get("Default")), 518 (`if default:`). If default truthy: line 519 (`if "List" in t:`) -- 520 returns split list, 521 returns default. Else lines 522 (allowed_values), 523 (`if len(allowed_values) > 0:`). If True: line 524 (`if "List" in t:`) -- 525 returns split list, 526 returns allowed_values[0]. Else line 528 (`if "List" in t:`) -- 529 returns Fn::Select chain, or line 531 raises. (6) Branches NEVER exercised by any of the 15 tests: `AWS::AccountId` (lines 482-484), `AWS::NotificationARNs` (line 487), the SSM::Parameter raise (line 516), the no-parameter-declared raise (line 513), and the final raise (line 531). (7) Per-test test methods cover: 01: us-east-1+AWS::Region; 02: us-gov-east-1+AWS::Region (covers 475); 03: cn-north-1+AWS::Region (covers 477); 04: us-east-1+AWS::Partition; 05: us-east-1+AWS::StackId; 06: us-east-1+AWS::StackName; 07: us-east-1+AWS::URLSuffix (returns 'amazonaws.com'); 08: cn-north-1+AWS::URLSuffix (covers 477 + returns 'amazonaws.com.cn'); 09: us-east-1+AWS::NoValue; 10: us-east-1+ref='Foo' with runtime_params={'Foo': 'bar'} -- early return at line 466; 11: ref='MyParam', Default='v', Type='String'; 12: ref='MyListParam', Default='a,b,c', Type='CommaDelimitedList'; 13: ref='MyAllowed', AllowedValues=['x','y'], Type='String', no Default; 14: ref='MyAllowedList', AllowedValues=['a,b','c,d'], Type='CommaDelimitedList', no Default; 15: ref='MyListNoData', Type='CommaDelimitedList', no Default, no AllowedValues.

Template answer (must match exactly):
{"covered_lines":[]}

Instance file preview (read with tools using relative paths; repo files live at e.g. src/...):
- files/tests/qa/parser.py
- files/tests/qa/testcase.py

Task phase 1: use tools as needed, then reply with exactly DONE_WITH_FILE_READING.
Task phase 2: after the follow-up closes tool use, first give a brief derivation, then '## Answer' on its own line, then the final JSON answer object.

201:        self,
202:        s: str,
203:        params: Mapping[str, Any],
204:    ) -> Tuple[bool, str]:
205:        pattern = r"(\$|&){[a-zA-Z0-9\.:]+}"
206:        if not re.search(pattern, s):
207:            return (True, s)

209:        new_s = deepcopy(s)
210:        for k, v in params.items():
211:            if isinstance(v, dict):

213:                    hashlib.md5(json.dumps(v).encode("utf-8"), usedforsecurity=False)

216:                )
217:            new_s = re.sub(rf"\$\{{{k}\}}", v, new_s)
218:            new_s = re.sub(rf"\&\{{{k}\}}", re.sub("[^0-9a-zA-Z]+", "", v), new_s)
